name: Wo he Ta de Shijiemori
source:
One day, the end of the world came.
She and I, we are the last survivers.
In order to protect her, I locked her in the basement.
There is no food, no water, and of course she doesn't trust me at all...
What should I do, so we can find peace through the last time of our lives.

The choice of life and death;
Pain and contradiction;
Deep inside the heart, the dark desire;
And ... hidden behind, the secrets.

Faced with all this, I just want to shout out -
I will do my best to save her!

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=933036821]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
translation:
有一天，世界末日来临了。
我和她，是最后的幸存者。
为了保护她，我把她锁在地下室里。
没有食物，没有水，当然她根本不信任我……
我该怎么办，才能让我们平安度过生命的最后时光。

生与死的选择；
痛苦与矛盾；
内心深处，有黑暗的欲望；
还有……隐藏在背后的秘密。

面对这一切，我只想大声喊出来——
我会尽全力救她！

[来自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=933036821]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
